title: The WETH Back Door
summary: Deposit on WETH is denied, yet the Safe still wraps ETH through the catch-all.
lesson: A rule blocks a function, not an outcome. WETH wraps any ETH it receives, whatever the call says, so under a permissive catch-all, denying deposit does not stop wrapping.

rules.note: Allows every CALL without its own rule

steps.label: Send 1 ETH to WETH with no calldata
steps.note: No calldata means selector zero, and WETH has no rule for it. The catch-all allows the call, and WETH wraps the ETH all the same.

steps.label: Send 1 ETH to WETH calling a made-up function
steps.note: Any function WETH does not have runs the same wrapping code. A blocklist cannot name them all.
